title: crabsim model file
description: A crabsim model file. It holds the model only: a run's seed, length and warm-up are not part of it.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, for editors. crabsim ignores it, keeps it when saving, and never needs the file it names to exist.

description.description: What the model is, as a whole.

classes.description: The model's own classes, in any order. Each derives from a built-in class (Source, Station, Buffer, Drain) or from another class here.

instances.description: The material-flow objects, in the order a run initialises them.

ClassFile.description: A class of the model's own.

name.description: Unique among classes, and not the name of a built-in class.

parent.description: The class it derives from: Source, Station, Buffer, Drain or another class in the file.

attributes.description: Only the values this class changes from its parent.

Name.description: A name: not empty, and with no spaces at either end.

AttributesFile.description: The values a class or instance sets. Each applies to some built-in classes only, and anything left out is inherited.

interval.description: Source: the time between creating an MU and offering it on. Must be set somewhere in the chain of classes. 0 offers each MU at once.

process_time.description: Station: the time it works on each MU. 0 by default, a dummy Station that takes no time.

failures.description: Station: random failures. Left out, it never fails.

starting_mus.description: Station: how many MUs it holds from the start of a run, 0 or 1.

capacity.description: Buffer: how many MUs it holds. Must be set somewhere in the chain of classes.

dimensions.description: Any object: its size in metres and rotation in degrees. Visual only.

description.description: Any object: free text saying what it is. Visual only.

Time.description: A time, written as crabsim's UI shows it: seconds, minutes and seconds, or hours, minutes and seconds, with days in front and a fraction of a second at the end. Such as "90", "1:30", "8:00:00", "2d 06:00:00", "3d" or "0:00:12.5".

FailuresFile.description: Random failures. The time between failures follows from the availability and the repair time.

availability.description: The share of time available, above 0 and below 1.

RepairTimeFile.description: How long a repair takes: exactly one of these.

oneOf.description: Normally distributed with this mean and standard deviation.
Erlang distributed with this mean and shape `k`.

rotation_degrees.description: Around the vertical axis, 0 if left out.

class.description: Source, Station, Buffer, Drain or a class in the file.

stream.description: Its stream: with a run's seed, it gives the instance's random numbers, so runs of two variants with the same seed draw the same numbers for it. Unique in the model. crabsim gives one when the instance is placed: changing it ends pairing with every earlier run.

position.description: The centre of its footprint, in metres. Visual only.

successors.description: The instances it passes MUs to, by name, in the order they are tried.

attributes.description: Only the values set on this instance. Anything else comes from its class.

z.description: Height above the floor, 0 if left out.
